review: Good at clashing and really good at helping to maintain Rupture. Rosespanner Gregor is good at maintaining his charge for his S3, although he does need atleast one other tremor unit to get his full potential. Really only used in Rupture teams, not much good anywhere else. Notable E.G.O Synergies: AEDD - Fuels the E.G.O. that is arguably irreplaceable in Rupture Team as it can easily provide a lot of count that rupture IDs struggle with applying.
